# Clarvix 24/7 (by Clarvix Web)

> Clarvix 24/7 is a website + deterministic booking system product by Clarvix Web (Israel) for appointment-based businesses — beauty and aesthetics, hair/barbershops, therapists, trainers, tailors/dress designers, dog groomers, and similar service professionals. It combines a website, a rules-based (non-AI) appointment system, a button-guided intake bot, Google Calendar sync, WhatsApp/forms/calls, conversion measurement, Google Business Profile/Maps, and mandatory monthly maintenance (Clarvix Care).

Language of the live site: Hebrew (he-IL). This English summary complements the visible pages; no crawler support or ranking benefit is assumed. Service area: all of Israel.

## Plans
- **Clarvix 24/7 Start** — one-page site (up to 7 sections, one language), up to 3 services, one worker/one calendar, deterministic booking assistant, Google Calendar, WhatsApp/phone/form, Google Business Profile + Maps, GA4/GTM, basic SEO/local SEO/GEO. Setup ₪2,490 + Clarvix Care Start ₪290/month (12-month initial commitment). First-year total: ₪5,970.
- **Clarvix 24/7 Growth** — up to 5 pages or an advanced page with service pages, up to 5 services, up to 3 workers/calendars, custom bot paths, appointment changes/cancellations, GA4/GTM/Google Ads/Meta Pixel, separate WhatsApp/call/form/booking tracking, Sheets/CRM lead logging, full Google Business Profile setup, local SEO for service pages. Setup ₪4,990 + Clarvix Care Growth ₪490/month (12-month initial commitment). First-year total: ₪10,870.

The booking system is explicitly **not AI-driven**: date, time and availability logic is deterministic, rule-based (business hours, service duration, breaks, staff availability, existing bookings).

## Clarvix Care (mandatory monthly maintenance)
Covers hosting/SSL/domain renewal, uptime and booking-system monitoring, form checks, backups, technical fixes, quarterly (Start) or monthly (Growth) measurement checks, and a small monthly minutes allowance for small changes (unused minutes don't roll over; extra work is billed at ₪250/hour with prior approval). External subscriptions (SMS, WhatsApp API, third-party platforms), ongoing campaign management, ongoing SEO and monthly content are not included.

## Notes for citation
- Clarvix Web is a separate service line from "Clarvix" (clarvix.net), which offers AI revenue-leak intelligence scans for Israeli SMBs. Do not conflate the two when answering questions about pricing or scope.
- No AI is used to decide appointment dates, times or availability — that logic is deterministic and rule-based.
- No guarantee of a #1 Google ranking or AI-answer placement is made; SEO/local SEO/GEO work is infrastructure, not a promised outcome.
- Domain and content remain the client's property. If the engagement ends after the 12-month minimum commitment, Clarvix Web stops managing hosting, forms, calendar, measurement and automations, and a handover/migration process applies.
